subject.title: [Bug] Telegram inbound images download but are not passed to model as vision input

question: Should current-turn image resolution forward source-aligned partial native images when some same-turn attachments fail, or keep the current all-or-nothing prompt-ref fallback until a richer alignment contract exists?
rationale: The linked PR changes user-visible media delivery semantics in a shared channel path, and the current blocker depends on the intended partial-media contract rather than a purely mechanical cleanup.

options.title: Repair aligned partial delivery
options.body: Allow partial native forwarding only after preserving failed attachment positions through the downstream prompt-image boundary, adding missing-first/missing-middle coverage, and collecting real transport proof.

options.title: Keep all-or-nothing fallback
options.body: Preserve the current fallback contract and close or narrow the linked PR if partial native delivery is not the desired behavior.

options.title: Defer under canonical issue
options.body: Leave this issue open while the linked PR remains blocked on proof and contract direction.

recommendation.title: Repair aligned partial delivery
recommendation.body: Allow partial native forwarding only after preserving failed attachment positions through the downstream prompt-image boundary, adding missing-first/missing-middle coverage, and collecting real transport proof.

likelyOwner.reason: vincentkoc recently owned the mixed image-order contract in the same resolver and has substantial Telegram/media history near this surface.
